Upgraded Corner Villa with 3 Bedrooms + Maid’s Room | Extended Layout | Beautifully Landscaped Garden

Key Features:

3 Bedrooms + Maid’s Room
5 Bathrooms
Built-Up Area: 3,509 sq. ft
Plot Size: 6,304.42 sq. ft
Landscaped Front & Rear Gardens
Upgraded Kitchen
Extended Layout
Open Plan Living Spaces
Well-Maintained Condition
4-Car Garage
Available Immediately
Park Located Directly Across the Road

All three bedrooms include built-in wardrobe space, with the master bedroom featuring a twin en-suite bathroom and access to a private terrace.

Outside, the villa is complemented by beautifully maintained front and rear landscaped gardens, offering a peaceful outdoor living environment.

About Jumeirah Park – District 8

District 8 is a tranquil sub-community within Jumeirah Park, located on the southwestern edge of the development. Known for its spacious and well-designed villas, District 8 offers a family-friendly atmosphere with convenient access to major areas including Jumeirah Village Triangle, Discovery Gardens, and Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT). Residents enjoy lush green parks, children’s play areas, and a serene, suburban lifestyle with proximity to key leisure and retail destinations.

Presented by:

Provident Real Estate
